name: mcp-server-cards
description: MCP Server Cards (SEP-2127) for Codex: find the MCP servers a domain publishes, check their Server Cards, and add one to Codex once you approve it in a form

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to a company's MCP server by its domain
interface.longDescription: Finds the MCP servers a domain publishes through its AI Catalog (/.well-known/ai-catalog.json), checks each Server Card against the SEP-2127 schema, and adds the one you pick to Codex's MCP configuration after you approve it in a form. Secrets are written as environment variable names, never as values, and sign-in stays Codex's own (codex mcp login). A community polyfill, not affiliated with OpenAI or the Model Context Protocol project.
defaultPrompt: What MCP servers does neon.com publish?
Connect Codex to Buildkite's MCP server
